subject: [PATCH v3 3/3] mm: zswap: drop cold writeback folios via swap dropbehind

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the zswap writeback process by allocating a folio off the LRU and marking it for dropbehind, allowing the swap cache to free it once writeback completes. This reduces memory waste and minimizes the time cold pages remain resident. The approach taken is to modify the zswap_writeback_entry function to set the PG_dropbehind flag on the allocated folio.
